<b>Hokers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are spine-shooting drifters of [[Pharloom]]'s lowlands who have fleecy down and a mask.<ref>Hoker [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Spine-shooting drifter of the lowlands. Whatever admiration I had for its fleecy down is spoilt by its disturbing mask..."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Hokers hover idly, even if approached by Hornet. When hit or affected by [[Needolin]], they shoot sharp spines straight out from their body, which continue travelling until they hit Hornet or the environment. After a few moments, additional spines appear facing new directions. When defeated, the Hoker shoots one last volley of spines before dying. <br>
Hokers can only have symmetrical spine configurations, and can have a maximum of 6 spines on their body at once.

Attacking Hokers or playing the Needolin is required for the <i>[[Flexile Spines]]</i> [[Wish]] - Hornet must collect [[Spine Core]]s by striking the Hokers' spines after they have been expelled. [[Sting Shard]]s are incredibly effective at gathering the Spine Cores, as throwing a Sting Shard at the centre of a Hoker will kill it in one go and cause it to drop all primed spines on death in item form.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin
| columns = 2
|
* Rising heat...
* Dwellings deep...
* Spines to spear...
* Predators near...
}}

== Location ==
Hokers can be found in the eastern [[Far Fields]], in rooms to the right of the [[Seamstress]]' house.

The Hoker below the [[Far_Fields#Skull_Cave|Skull Cave]] starts to spawn only after the start of [[Act 2]].
